verdict.rationale: Honeycomb publishes a public pricing page with a self-serve, free-forever plan and explicit volume limits (up to 20M events and 100M metrics data points per month), so some cost predictability is possible without contacting sales. The evidence shows only free-tier limits, not actual per-signal prices or paid-tier rates. Missing for 10: published paid-tier per-event/per-data-point pricing, overage rates, evidence that higher tiers are self-serve without sales, and independent corroboration of cost predictability.
